**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** (after #957, which this PR is stacked on).

Reviewed at full rigour as a collision/reach law (safety floor).

### What looks good
- Conservativeness holds. `BodyBands::of` (body_bands.rs) only carries a stack that is contiguous from the shank top, tops out at the holder's top, and has no band wider than max(holder, shank) radius. `drill_reach::stack_bands` re-checks the same (finite, `above >= reach`, `r <= max(hr, shank_r)+TOL`). Anything else falls back to the old holder cylinder, so the check can only ever equal the old one where the body is not trusted, and no band is wider than the cylinder it replaces. Where a band is narrower the law reads narrower material under it (the real body), never wider than before.
- Gaps: none possible, since the bands are contiguous from the shank top to the holder top; the axial law checks each band's own lower face disc, the cross law sweeps each band's own footprint/tube.
- Pinning in both directions: stepped body whose flange clears is no longer refused, flange that reaches is still refused and named (axial, cross holder, cross part, probe stylus, and end to end through `operation::generate`); a nose narrower than the flange but beside a near wall is convicted by the nose band; no body / cylinder-equal stack / over-wide stack reads bit-identically (refusal text pinned to the byte).
- Unchanged verdicts: the existing drill, cross-drill, probe and tool-body suites all pass unchanged; no golden or snapshot touched.
- Hull/seg helpers moved verbatim to `drill_hull.rs`; `drill_reach.rs` stays at 394 lines.
- Process: `Fixes #842`, `Changelog:` line, decision file `docs/decisions/842-band-stack-drill-probe.md`, no CHANGELOG/RECOMMENDED edits, no snapshot PNGs, no build.rs/.github/scripts/deps, no process files.

### Interaction with other PRs
- `git merge-tree` of this head against #973 (upright tilt tolerance): clean, no conflicts.
- `git merge-tree` against #957: clean (this PR contains #957's commit `54ed3fe7`).
- Suggested order: #957, then #993 (retarget not needed, base is main), #973 in any position.

### Local results (trial-merged with upstream/main, clean merge)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| app lib (incl. `drill_reach::body_tests`, `cross_part::tests`) | 118 passed |
| app tests: tool_body_drill_probe 5, probe_reach 5, probe_op 12, probe_pick 9, probe_search 3, drill_reach 6, drill_reach_fit 3, drilling_axial 7, drilling_cross 9, drilling_cross_holder 2, drilling_cross_part 3, drilling_cross_spindle 7, drilling_cross_stock 8, drilling_cross_box 7, drilling_cross_rapids 2, lathe_cross_drill 5, tool_body 12, tool_body_bands 13, tool_body_judged 8, tool_neck_laws 4, sim_tool_body 7, tool_cutter_profile 5, tool_spun_profile 7, drill_prior 12, drill_prior_kinds 4 | all passed |
| camcraft-tools | 62 + 3 passed |
| camcraft-sim lib 70; midmove_pose 5; overhang_laws 13; fixture_stack_span 8 | all passed |
| camcraft-motion solid_law | 6 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

I did not re-run the full quick plan (the author reports it green, 1526 tests); the suites above are the ones that cover the touched modules.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
1. A carried band wider than the record's enclosing holder is distrusted and the cylinder stands in (the pre-#842 reading), so such a body is judged no wider than before, not wider. `BodyBands::of` already refuses that case, so this is the intended fallback; just be aware the fallback is "as before", not "more conservative".
2. The end-to-end cross-drill path with an imported mesh body is not exercised (stated in the PR); the law-level tests cover it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 50992dbaaf7f4ab52b311129e5a08bfbcc8bdce2 -->
**Independent review (maintainer side, high tier). Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge** - merge #957 first (see Overlap below).

This review was not written by the PR's author. It covers a collision/reach law, so it was done at the safety floor. For each of the three laws I checked which way every verdict moves.

### What looks good
- **Drill reach, axial holder face** (`drill_reach.rs` `axial_reach`, `stack_bands`). Each band's face disc is now judged at the band's own radius against the material top over that disc. A band narrower than the enclosing cylinder is excused only from material outside its own radius. A wider band higher up is judged at its own face. `BodyBands::of` requires the bands to run without a gap from the shank top to the holder top, so no height is left unjudged. For a Drill cycle the depth law keeps depth <= flute, so no band can enter the hole the drill just made. Tap, bore and back-bore cycles go through `shank_fits` first.
- **Cross-drill holder** (`band_clear`). The on-station tube and the swing's swept rectangle run once per band, at that band's face, radius and length. No band is skipped for being narrow. Each move uses its own pose axis, so tilted and 4th-axis poses read the pose as before.
- **Cross-drill part law.** `Cutter::judged(geom, Some(cutter))` re-judges the carried stack, and a stack that does not fit falls back to the plain stack.
- **Probe stylus** (`stylus_cutter` / `stylus_body`). The bands are ball, stem, probe body (the record's shank) and then the body's bands, checked as a `BodyBands` of the stylus stack. Any overlap, gap or over-wide band leaves the one enclosing band. Every probing move goes through `solid_hits`, approach and retract included.
- **Fallbacks.** No body, a cylinder-equal stack, or a non-finite, over-wide or non-contiguous stack all fall back to the holder cylinder, never to nothing. Refusal text with no body is pinned to the byte.
- **Refusal wording.** Messages now name the band actually judged: "body band (dia. D, A mm above the tip)". The enclosure wording is kept only where the cylinder is still what gets read (`body_judged::falls_back`, the probe note).
- **Laws.** No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` outside tests. No `Cargo.toml` change, so no new crate dependency. No golden or snapshot PNG moved. Tests sit in the crate that owns the behaviour. The decision file is `docs/decisions/842-band-stack-drill-probe.md`. The body has `Changelog:` and ends `Fixes #842`.

### Scratch tests I added (local only, not committed)
- **Axial, pocket (half-width 4) narrower than a step, nose r3.8 inside the pocket.** A step r6 at 30 mm (face Z -4, under the top) **convicts**, naming `body band (dia. 12.000, 30.000 mm above the tip)`. The same step moved to 35 mm (face above the top) is clean. A nose r4.5, wider than the pocket, convicts at the nose. With raw stock over the hole, the R-plane law refuses first, which errs on the safe side.
- **Cross drill, deep plunge into a square cross hole (half-width 2) through a core.** A nose r1.8 inside the hole with the flange face outside the core is clean. A nose r3 (wider than the hole) convicts. A flange whose face sits inside the core convicts.
- **Probe, r10 probe body beside a narrow tower behind the approach.** It is convicted as a `ShankHit` (blocks the post). A tower beyond reach stays clean.

### Local results (trial-merged with current `origin/main`, clean merge, includes #911's `model_excess`)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| merged tree compiles (`cargo test -p camcraft-app --tests --no-run`) | ok |
| camcraft-sim `--tests` | 52 binaries, 432 passed, 0 failed |
| camcraft-tools | 4 binaries, 65 passed, 0 failed |
| camcraft-motion `--tests` | 67 binaries, 712 passed, 0 failed |
| camcraft-app lib | 122 passed |
| app: conformance 6, drill_prior 12, drill_prior_kinds 4, drill_reach 6, drill_reach_fit 3, drill_rplane 8, drilling_axial 7, drilling_cross 9, drilling_cross_box 7, drilling_cross_holder 2, drilling_cross_part 3, drilling_cross_rapids 2, drilling_cross_spindle 7, drilling_cross_stock 8, golden_cl 25, probe_guard 5, probe_only_sim 2, probe_op 12, probe_pick 9, probe_reach 5, probe_search 3, sim_tool_body 7, tool_body 12, tool_body_bands 13, tool_body_drill_probe 5, tool_body_judged 8, tool_cutter_profile 5, tool_neck_laws 4, tool_spun_profile 7, verify 21 | all pass, 0 failed |
| clippy `-D warnings` on sim, tools, motion, app (`--all-targets`) | clean |

### Requested before merge
None.

### Overlap with #957 (necked tools)
This branch carries #957's commit `54ed3fe7` in full. #842's own change is the single commit on top of it. Merge **#957 first**, then this PR. Merging #993 first would bring #957's change in unreviewed as part of this PR, and #957 would then show as merged by side effect.

### Notes (non-blocking)
- `crates/app/src/operation/job.rs` grows from 397 to 401 lines. That growth comes from #957's commit, and it is just past the ~400-line guide. `generate.rs` (already about 3,260 lines) grows by 15 lines.
- `name_enclosure` now adds the enclosure words only when the body falls back. The multi-axis dodge (`shank_of`, `generate.rs`) still reads the holder cylinder. If that path ever produces a refusal that names the holder for a body that does fit, it would no longer say the cylinder was judged. This is a wording point only: the verdict stays on the safe side.
- `stack_bands` repeats the checks `BodyBands::of` already makes (finite, at or above the shank top, no wider than the enclosing holder). This is harmless double protection.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
